memo: v34 = our v31 (Budget-Fit v5 by verracodeguacas, Apache-2.0, + our partner-file table; 0.20, our best) with 28 calls / 8 min kept, bundled with three parts that cannot lengthen a run: six tools only (graph tools and their prompt line removed; dheerajpiduru's six-tool v8 averaged 11/58 over two scores vs about 9.9 for Budget-Fit V5 over 16), the task statement pinned at the end of the system prompt (survives the 14k history compaction), and a one-word finish after submit_patch (bliverrigpdoge v3). Not taken: 40 calls (our v33 with 40 calls = 0.15; dheerajpiduru's 40-call v10 hit the 12-hour limit). Reading of v33 = 0.15: 40 calls lengthen runs under the shared 12-hour limit / 8-minute cap, plus noise (one run SD about 2.3 tasks; 0.20 -> 0.15 is about 3 tasks = 1.3 SD). Effect estimate for v34 vs v31: +1 to +2 tasks (0.017 each), inside one run's noise, so a bundle check, not a claim. Hypothesis: completes and LB >= 0.20. Final picks: no selection API; Kaggle uses the best two public scores when none are selected = v31 0.20 and v21-3 0.18; v34 replaces v21-3 only if it scores >= 0.20. Source: bases/v34_SOURCE.txt.
